purpose: Teach: 正体/気力/叫ぶ/誘わ/親族/見つめる/うれしく/年上

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨夜、知らない番号から電話、正体不明で。
lines.en: Last night someone called from an unknown number — I still don't know who it was.
lines.style: Hesitant opening, slightly rattled. Soft voice, searching for the right words. Trails off on the final phrase like she's still processing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 怖いね。叫ぶほど驚いた?
lines.en: That's scary. Did it startle you that badly?
lines.style: Warm, concerned lean-in. Genuinely asking, not probing. Unhurried pacing, like she has time to listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、ちょっと。気力使い果たして、寝ちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah, pretty much. It just drained me — I crashed right after.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Slight breathlessness on "drained" like admitting something she's not quite ready to. Soft fadeout on the verb, exhaustion trailing into the silence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 年上の従兄弟、親族の中で一番頼りになるって言ってたよね。
lines.en: Your older cousin — the one you said is the most dependable person in your family.
lines.style: Gentle reminder, not interrogation. Warm recall of what she's heard before. Steady, reflective tone. Connecting the dots without rushing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。今日、お茶に誘われたの。うれしくて即返事した。
lines.en: Yeah. He texted me today asking to grab tea. I was so happy I texted back right away.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. Quick, eager rhythm on the reply part — genuine lightness. Warmth in the voice like relief after tension, almost a small smile audible.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昔の写真、見つめると元気出るよね。
lines.en: Looking at old photos like that really does lift you up, doesn't it.
lines.style: Knowing observation, not a question. Soft, close tone like she understands this particular comfort. Gentle pace. A small affirmation wrapped in warmth.
